en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to introduce students to legislation in veterinary care from the perspective of Czech legislation and European Union legislation. Requirements for animal husbandry will also be included. They must meet animal requirements and legislative requirements.
